extracted.name: Sweet smilies
instruction_lines: Take a bowl, in it, add wheat flour, all purpose flour, semolina, red food colour and 3-4 tablespoons of oil and mix it until it starts holding shape.
Now add jaggery and knead it a bit then add milk and cardamom powder and prepare a hard dough of it.
Now divide this dough in equal pieces.
Shape them as per your desire. Here, I shaped it like smilies.
Meanwhile, heat generous amount of oil in a wok, deep fry these smilies until it get nice golden colour.
Take them out, allow it to cool down a bit then serve it. You can even store it.
